init.title: SmartIR options
init.description:
Update the UI-configured SmartIR entity and adjust repeat timing for a selected command.

For MQTT and UFO-R11 (Moes/Tuya ZS06) IR blasters via Zigbee2MQTT, enter the `/set` topic such as `zigbee2mqtt/ufo_r11/set`. For Infrared, choose an existing Home Assistant `infrared.*` emitter entity. Native infrared receiver learning is not supported here yet.
